payload.reason: The evidence specifies the pretrained word embeddings used in the experiments, including GloVe and Edinburgh embeddings, and compares their performance.

claims.text: The pretrained word embeddings used include GloVe and Edinburgh embeddings.
Emoji embeddings outperform plain GloVe and Edinburgh embeddings in certain contexts.
Edinburgh embeddings perform better than GloVe in Joy and Sadness categories but worse in Anger and Fear categories.
